message.content: Li Hua engages in a conversation with HaileyJohnson about the bakery's doorstep delivery service, expressing interest in the convenience it offers, particularly for acquiring fresh bread. Hailey proposes a trial run of the service, and Li Hua agrees to set up a delivery for the upcoming Tuesday. While discussing the delivery options, Li Hua inquires about the frequency of the deliveries, to which Hailey responds that she can accommodate deliveries a couple of times a week, depending on Li Hua's needs. Hailey also offers the possibility of arranging a regular delivery schedule, should Li Hua prefer a more consistent service. Thus, Li Hua shows openness to the delivery service, indicating a willingness to see how frequently it suits her, with the option of potentially establishing a more regular delivery cadence if it becomes necessary or desired.
